title: Actors and Sendable: data-race safety
hints: Swift 6 refuses to compile the class version: a mutable class shared between tasks is a data race. Change `final class BankAccount` to `actor BankAccount`.
Outside the actor, calls need await: await account.deposit(1). Inside withTaskGroup, each addTask can safely call the actor. Transaction is a struct of Sendable fields, so mark it `: Sendable`.
